A.domain: Subtraction of fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification

skills.name: Equalize fraction units
skills.definition: Find or use a common denominator and rewrite fractions as equivalent fractions so the fractional parts are expressed in the same unit before subtraction.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly finds an LCD/common denominator.
Tag when a step converts one or both fractions to equivalent fractions with a shared denominator.
Tag for mixed-number items when only the fractional parts are rewritten to a common denominator.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no conversion is performed.
Do not tag simple rewriting of a whole number as n + 0/d unless it is part of borrowing rather than denominator equalization.
Do not tag normalization of an improper mixed number unless the step also changes denominators to a common unit.

skills.name: Normalize number form
skills.definition: Rewrite a whole number, fraction, or mixed number into a subtraction-ready form such as converting an improper mixed number to a standard mixed number or expressing a whole number as a whole plus zero fractional part.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a mixed number with an improper fraction part is normalized, such as 2 3/2 to 3 1/2.
Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a whole plus 0/d to align with a mixed number or fraction.
Tag when a mixed number is explicitly decomposed into whole and fractional parts for later subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary subtraction of already-ready whole and fraction parts.
Do not tag finding a common denominator; that belongs to denominator equalization.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping after subtraction has produced a negative fractional part.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Subtract numerators of like fractions and/or subtract the whole-number and fractional parts once the quantities are in compatible form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when same-denominator fractions are subtracted by subtracting numerators.
Tag when mixed numbers are handled by subtracting whole parts and fraction parts separately without borrowing.
Tag when subtraction is performed after denominator equalization or normalization.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag steps whose main purpose is creating common denominators.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping steps that adjust a negative fractional result.
Do not tag simplification-only steps such as reducing 9/12 to 3/4 or 0/3 to 0.

skills.name: Regroup and simplify
skills.definition: Resolve subtraction results that require borrowing across whole and fractional parts and reduce or express the final result in lowest terms, integer form, or mixed-number form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a whole is borrowed and converted into fractional units to continue subtraction.
Tag when a fraction or zero result is simplified, such as 2/10 to 1/5 or 0/3 to 0.
Tag when the final whole and fractional parts are combined into a mixed number, fraction, or integer after subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag initial rewriting of numbers into subtraction-ready form before any need to borrow is established.
Do not tag common-denominator conversion.
Do not tag straightforward subtraction steps that do not involve regrouping or final simplification/combination.

B.domain: Subtracting fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification

skills.name: Align fractional units
skills.definition: Make fractional parts directly comparable by finding a common denominator or rewriting a whole number with an appropriate fractional part denominator.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution finds an LCD/common denominator and converts one or both fractions to equivalent fractions.
Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a whole plus 0 over a chosen denominator so fraction parts can be subtracted.
Tag when a fraction is explicitly rewritten into equivalent fractional units before subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no rewriting into common units is performed.
Do not tag for simplifying a result after subtraction.
Do not tag for borrowing/regrouping after subtraction has begun.

skills.name: Normalize mixed numbers
skills.definition: Rewrite a mixed number with an improper fractional part into an equivalent standard mixed number before subtracting.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a mixed number such as 2 3/2 or 1 5/3 is converted to an equivalent mixed number with a proper fractional part.
Tag when the solution explicitly states 'normalize' or performs the equivalent rewrite before subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag for rewriting a whole number as a whole plus 0 over a denominator; that belongs to aligning fractional units.
Do not tag for borrowing/regrouping during subtraction.
Do not tag when mixed numbers are already in standard form.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Subtract the quantities once they are in compatible form, including subtracting numerators for like fractions and subtracting whole and fractional parts of mixed numbers without borrowing.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution subtracts numerators of fractions with the same denominator.
Tag when the solution subtracts whole parts and fraction parts of mixed numbers directly.
Tag when the solution combines the direct subtraction result into a fraction, mixed number, or integer, provided no borrowing step is involved.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag for finding a common denominator or rewriting whole numbers into fractional units before subtraction.
Do not tag for borrowing/regrouping when the fractional part would otherwise be negative.
Do not tag for reducing a nonfinal fraction to lowest terms.

skills.name: Borrow and simplify
skills.definition: Regroup one whole into fractional units when needed during subtraction and reduce the resulting fraction or zero form to lowest terms.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution borrows 1 from the whole part and converts it into denominator-over-denominator fractional units.
Tag when the solution uses the borrowed fractional units to complete the subtraction.
Tag when the solution simplifies a result such as 2/10 to 1/5, 9/12 to 3/4, or 0/3 to 0.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag for direct subtraction that does not require regrouping and does not include simplification.
Do not tag for initial common-denominator conversion or normalization of improper mixed numbers.
Do not tag for merely combining already-simplified whole and fractional parts.

C.domain: Subtraction of fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification

skills.name: Equalize fraction units
skills.definition: Find a common denominator and rewrite fractional parts as equivalent fractions with that denominator before subtraction.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly finds an LCD/common denominator.
Tag when a step converts one or both fractions to equivalent fractions with matching denominators.
Tag for mixed-number subtraction when only the fractional parts are rewritten to a common denominator.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no conversion is performed.
Do not tag mere rewriting of a whole number as n + 0/d unless it is part of borrowing rather than denominator matching.
Do not tag normalization of an improper mixed number unless the step also changes denominators to equivalent fractions.

skills.name: Normalize composite numbers
skills.definition: Rewrite whole numbers or mixed numbers into a subtraction-ready form, such as converting a whole number to n + 0/d or normalizing a mixed number with an improper fractional part.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a whole plus a zero fraction to align with a mixed number or fraction.
Tag when a mixed number with an improper fractional part is normalized to an equivalent standard mixed number.
Tag when a mixed number is explicitly decomposed into whole and fractional parts for later subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag common-denominator conversion of ordinary fractions; that belongs to S01.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping after subtraction has produced a negative fractional part; that belongs to S04.
Do not tag the final recombination of whole and fractional results.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Subtract fractions with like denominators and/or subtract the whole-number and fractional parts separately once the quantities are in compatible form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when numerators are subtracted over a shared denominator.
Tag when whole parts and fraction parts of mixed numbers are subtracted separately.
Tag when subtraction is performed after normalization or denominator alignment, even if the intermediate fractional result is zero or negative.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag steps whose main purpose is creating a common denominator; that belongs to S01.
Do not tag rewriting numbers into mixed or decomposed form; that belongs to S02.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping to fix a negative fractional part; that belongs to S04.

skills.name: Regroup and simplify result
skills.definition: Borrow/regroup across whole and fractional parts when needed, then simplify and express the final result in lowest terms or integer/mixed-number form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when 1 whole is borrowed and converted into denominator/denominator to continue subtraction.
Tag when a fraction or zero fraction is simplified to lowest terms or to an integer.
Tag when the final whole and fractional parts are combined into the reported answer.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag initial setup steps that only normalize numbers before subtraction; that belongs to S02.
Do not tag common-denominator work before subtraction; that belongs to S01.
Do not tag straightforward subtraction itself unless the step is specifically the post-borrow subtraction within regrouping.
